temporary_file_deviation.description: Initial PySAT proof-logging calls used tempfile.TemporaryFile() without explicitly setting its directory. These anonymous temporary proof files used the interpreter's system temporary directory, rather than the requested referee directory.
temporary_file_deviation.impact: Procedural write-scope deviation; does not alter the CNFs, assignments, saved certificates, or certificate-checking mathematics.
temporary_file_deviation.correction: recompute.py, refine_unknowns.py and fast_certificates.py now explicitly set tempfile.tempdir to their own referee directory. Compiler scratch uses TMPDIR set to that directory. One old refinement was interrupted; its already retained candidate proof is checked separately before any verdict is adopted.
temporary_file_deviation.closed: Initial solver scopes were closed or their process ended, closing their anonymous proof descriptors.

interrupted_attempt.promotion_rule: The retained candidate is not counted as a certified verdict unless the separate compiled RUP check succeeds. The second requested level was not reached by this interrupted command.

checker_provenance: Both checkers are fresh implementations of watched-literal unit propagation. Neither calls a SAT solver. The compiled checker is compared with a plain propagation oracle and with the Python checker. This is AI-authored independent recomputation, not human or external replication.

large_proof_check_interruption.new_result_rule: only a completed check may promote the candidate
